_about: Which questions ask for a block palette. Read by the Discord bot (personality.palette) and the mod (MerlLines.palette), on normalized text (lower case, no punctuation or apostrophes). {NAME} is replaced by parts[NAME]; a pattern must match the whole text, and with patterns are tried in order, the block in the group named block.

parts.WHAT: (what|which|wat)( are| r| would be| is| s)?( some| the| a few)?( good| nice| best| other| matching| fitting| complementary)*( kind of| kinds of| type of| types of)?
parts.ADJ: ( good| nice| cool| new| random| pretty| fun| fresh| simple| neat| great| cute| cozy)*
parts.END: ( please| pls| plz| for me| to build with| idea| ideas| merl)?
